info.description: REST API for Suda Transaction Service: custodial wallets, SUDA transfers, donations, token-gating, purchases, treasury statistics.
info.title: Suda Transaction Service API

post.description: Send a SUDA donation. Exactly one of to_username or to_channel_id must be set. Returns tx_hash immediately; observer indexes donation asynchronously and emits DONATION_SENT/DONATION_RECEIVED WS events.
post.summary: Donate SUDA to a user or channel

post.description: Sets a token-gating rule for a channel (minimum SUDA balance and/or required NFT collection). Channel OWNER only.
post.summary: Create or update a gating rule

get.description: Returns the current gating rule (if any). Available to any authenticated user — the threshold is public.
get.summary: Get gating rule for a channel

delete.description: Removes the gating rule for a channel. Channel OWNER only.

get.description: Paginated list of purchases for the authenticated user (any status).

post.description: Creates a PENDING purchase. Returns purchase_id for follow-up Confirm call.

get.description: Public catalog of SUDA purchase packages with fiat prices.

post.description: Simulates a payment for an existing PENDING purchase. Treasury broadcasts the SUDA Transfer; observer creates a PURCHASE_COMPLETED WS event for the buyer.

get.description: Returns the channel's treasury wallet address and on-chain SUDA balance. Available to channel OWNER or ADMIN.
Paginated list of donations to a channel with resolved usernames. OWNER/ADMIN only.
Aggregated donation stats for a channel: on-chain balance, total donations count/amount, top donors. OWNER/ADMIN only.
Returns confirmed on-chain transactions involving the user's wallet (transfers, donations, purchases).
Returns the authenticated user's custodial wallet address and on-chain SUDA balance.

post.description: Looks up a user by username and returns their user_id, display_name and wallet_address (if any).
Custodial P2P transfer of SUDA tokens. Returns tx_hash immediately (async confirmation via WS event SUDA_RECEIVED/SUDA_SENT). If chat_id is provided, a system message is posted to that chat.
